benefits.text: The hince All-Round Eye Palette, a 5-color eyeshadow palette, is easy to use every day, with neutral shades that are easy to blend and combine. Its compact design is easy to carry with you, suited to your busy days. Versatile, easy-to-use colors in large pans make application easier and more convenient.

howToUse.text: Use a finger or brush to pick up an appropriate amount, apply to the eye area you want to make up and blend gently.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

texture.text: Pressed eyeshadow, including matte and shimmer shades.

positioning.text: A 5-color neutral beige brown eyeshadow palette, easy for everyday use and convenient to carry.

sellingPoints.text: 5 versatile colors; neutral tones that are easy to pair; compact design, large pans for easy pickup.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say the color is absolutely long-lasting or 100% fallout-free. The shimmer effect depends on the eye base and how it is used.

positioning.text: A 5-color deep brown eyeshadow palette that creates natural depth and an elegant classic style.

sellingPoints.text: 5 versatile colors; deep brown tones that easily create depth; compact and convenient to carry.

finish.text: Deep brown / soft and smooth / light shimmer.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim smudge-proof/wear-proof unless the source states it. Build the deep browns layer by layer to avoid heavy-looking eyes.

positioning.text: A 5-color dusty pink/dried rose petal eyeshadow palette that creates soft, romantic, easy-to-wear eye looks.

sellingPoints.text: 5 versatile colors; refined dusty pink tones; combines base colors, accent colors and shimmer.

finish.text: Dusty pink / soft / light sparkling shimmer.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say the colors absolutely suit every undertone. Dusty pink may show differently depending on skin tone/eye base.

positioning.text: A 5-color lavender pink eyeshadow palette for cool tones, creating a gentle, cool, clear and bright feel.

finish.text: Lavender pink / soft and bright / sheer shimmer.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say lavender truly whitens skin. Light/cool shades may show differently depending on the eye base.
